key_sub: Only like terms can be collected: 3x + 5x = 8x, but 3x + 2y stays as it is.
body_html:
How it works

An expression uses variables (letters), constants (numbers), operations and sometimes brackets. It has no equals sign. Translate words carefully: “5 less than n” is n − 5, and “3 lots of n + 2” needs brackets: 3(n + 2).

Like terms have exactly the same letters. Only like terms can be collected: 3x + 5x = 8x, but 3x + 2y stays as it is.

Example

Write “7 more than twice n”.

Twice n is 2n.

Then add 7.

Answer: 2n + 7

Example

Each bag holds n apples and 2 oranges. Write the total fruit in 3 bags.

One bag: n + 2.

Three bags: 3(n + 2).

Answer: 3(n + 2)

Example

Simplify 5x + 3y − 2x + y.

x terms: 3x.

y terms: 4y.

Answer: 3x + 4y

Common mistakes

  • Writing subtraction the wrong way round: “5 less than n” is n − 5, not 5 − n.
  • Leaving out brackets: 3 lots of (n + 2) is 3(n + 2), not 3n + 2.
  • Combining unlike terms: 3x + 2y is not 5xy.
  • Losing the sign in front of a term: 7n − n is 6n.

Terms with exactly the same letters and powers, such as 3x and −5x. They can be added or subtracted.

faq.q: How do I write “5 less than n”?
faq.a: n − 5. The 5 is taken away from n.

items.q: Write an expression for: half of n, plus 11.
items.e: n2 + 11.

items.q: Mia is a years old. Her cousin is 6 years older. Write an expression for her cousin's age.
items.e: Older means add: a + 6.

items.q: Mia is a years old. Her cousin is 4 years older. Write an expression for her cousin's age.
items.e: Older means add: a + 4.

items.q: Pies cost $5 each. Write an expression for the cost, in dollars, of n pies.
items.e: n pies at $5 each cost 5n dollars.

items.q: A bus has p passengers. At a stop 4 get off and 8 get on. Write an expression for the number of passengers now.
Movie tickets cost $t each and there is a $8 booking fee for the whole order. Write an expression for the cost of 8 tickets.
items.e: 8 tickets cost 8t, and the fee is added once: 8t + 8.

items.q: Liam has m dollars. He spends $7. Write an expression for the money he has left.
items.e: Spending means take away from what he has: m − 7.

items.q: Liam has m dollars. He spends $8. Write an expression for the money he has left.
items.e: Spending means take away from what he has: m − 8.

items.q: Pies cost $8 each. Write an expression for the cost, in dollars, of n pies.
items.e: n pies at $8 each cost 8n dollars.

items.q: Each show bag has n lollies and 12 stickers. Write an expression for the total number of items in 9 show bags.
items.e: Each bag has n + 12 items, and there are 9 bags: 9(n + 12). The brackets are needed.

items.q: A bus has p passengers. At a stop 3 get off and 8 get on. Write an expression for the number of passengers now.
Pies cost $9 each. Write an expression for the cost, in dollars, of n pies.
items.e: n pies at $9 each cost 9n dollars.

items.q: Pies cost $6 each. Write an expression for the cost, in dollars, of n pies.
items.e: n pies at $6 each cost 6n dollars.

items.q: Zara has s stickers and Kai has 6 times as many. Write an expression for the number they have altogether.
items.e: Zara has s and Kai has 6s. Together: s + 6s = 7s.

items.q: A square has sides of x cm. Write an expression for its perimeter.
items.e: Four equal sides: 4x.

items.q: Zara has s stickers and Kai has 2 times as many. Write an expression for the number they have altogether.
items.e: Zara has s and Kai has 2s. Together: s + 2s = 3s.

items.q: Liam has m dollars. He spends $3. Write an expression for the money he has left.
items.e: Spending means take away from what he has: m − 3.

items.q: Movie tickets cost $t each and there is a $7 booking fee for the whole order. Write an expression for the cost of 5 tickets.
items.e: 5 tickets cost 5t, and the fee is added once: 5t + 7.

items.q: A pizza is cut into s equal slices and shared equally by 8 friends. Write an expression for the slices each friend gets.
items.e: Sharing equally means dividing: s8.

items.q: Zara has s stickers and Kai has 3 times as many. Write an expression for the number they have altogether.
items.e: Zara has s and Kai has 3s. Together: s + 3s = 4s.

items.q: A bus has p passengers. At a stop 7 get off and 2 get on. Write an expression for the number of passengers now.
Simplify 6m − 4m.
items.e: All the terms are m terms, so add the numbers: 6 + (−4) = 2. The answer is 2m.

items.q: Simplify 3t + 9t − t.
items.e: All the terms are t terms, so add the numbers: 3 + 9 + (−1) = 11. The answer is 11t.

items.q: Simplify 9n + 5n + 4n.
items.e: All the terms are n terms, so add the numbers: 9 + 5 + 4 = 18. The answer is 18n.

items.q: Simplify 9p + 8p + 8p.
items.e: All the terms are p terms, so add the numbers: 9 + 8 + 8 = 25. The answer is 25p.

items.q: Simplify 5a + 7a + 8a.
items.e: All the terms are a terms, so add the numbers: 5 + 7 + 8 = 20. The answer is 20a.

items.q: Simplify 3m + 8m.
items.e: All the terms are m terms, so add the numbers: 3 + 8 = 11. The answer is 11m.

items.q: Simplify 6t + 6t.
items.e: All the terms are t terms, so add the numbers: 6 + 6 = 12. The answer is 12t.

items.q: Simplify 8n + 3n − n.
items.e: All the terms are n terms, so add the numbers: 8 + 3 + (−1) = 10. The answer is 10n.

items.q: Simplify 5a − 3a + 4a.
items.e: All the terms are a terms, so add the numbers: 5 + (−3) + 4 = 6. The answer is 6a.

items.q: Simplify 7n − 5n.
items.e: All the terms are n terms, so add the numbers: 7 + (−5) = 2. The answer is 2n.

items.q: Simplify 7y + 5y.
items.e: All the terms are y terms, so add the numbers: 7 + 5 = 12. The answer is 12y.

items.q: Simplify 9n + 8n − 2n.
items.e: All the terms are n terms, so add the numbers: 9 + 8 + (−2) = 15. The answer is 15n.

items.q: Simplify 5m + 2m.
items.e: All the terms are m terms, so add the numbers: 5 + 2 = 7. The answer is 7m.

items.q: Simplify 7x − 4x.
items.e: All the terms are x terms, so add the numbers: 7 + (−4) = 3. The answer is 3x.

items.q: Simplify 4b − 2b.
items.e: All the terms are b terms, so add the numbers: 4 + (−2) = 2. The answer is 2b.

items.q: Simplify 4m − 5m.
items.e: All the terms are m terms, so add the numbers: 4 + (−5) = −1. The answer is −m.

items.q: Simplify 6a − 5a.
items.e: All the terms are a terms, so add the numbers: 6 + (−5) = 1. The answer is a.

items.q: Simplify 8m − 6m − 3m.
items.e: All the terms are m terms, so add the numbers: 8 + (−6) + (−3) = −1. The answer is −m.

items.q: Simplify 2m + 5m + 8m.
items.e: All the terms are m terms, so add the numbers: 2 + 5 + 8 = 15. The answer is 15m.

items.q: Simplify 6p + 7p.
items.e: All the terms are p terms, so add the numbers: 6 + 7 = 13. The answer is 13p.
Collect the a terms (9a) and the m terms (−m), then the number. The answer is 9a − m − 5.
Collect the a terms (11a) and the p terms (6p), then the number. The answer is 11a + 6p + 4.
Collect the b terms (6b) and the x terms (−x), then the number. The answer is 6b − x + 7.
Collect the n terms (−3n) and the p terms (p), then the number. The answer is −3n + p − 5.
Collect the n terms (4n) and the p terms (5p), then the number. The answer is 4n + 5p − 2.
Collect the a terms (9a) and the t terms (9t), then the number. The answer is 9a + 9t − 3.
Collect the m terms (4m) and the x terms (4x), then the number. The answer is 4m + 4x + 9.

items.q: Simplify m + 5p − 3p + 3m.
items.e: Collect the m terms (4m) and the p terms (2p). The answer is 4m + 2p.

items.q: Simplify 3x − 6n − 4x + 5n.
items.e: Collect the n terms (−n) and the x terms (−x). The answer is −n − x.

items.q: Simplify 8a + 7m − 4m − 6a.
items.e: Collect the a terms (2a) and the m terms (3m). The answer is 2a + 3m.
Collect the t terms (3t) and the y terms (4y), then the number. The answer is 3t + 4y + 4.
Collect the b terms (10b) and the m terms (14m), then the number. The answer is 10b + 14m − 4.
Collect the m terms (5m) and the x terms (2x), then the number. The answer is 5m + 2x + 7.

items.q: Simplify 5m − 5p + 6m + 4p.
items.e: Collect the m terms (11m) and the p terms (−p). The answer is 11m − p.

items.q: Simplify 8x − 3b − 4x + 6b.
items.e: Collect the b terms (3b) and the x terms (4x). The answer is 3b + 4x.

items.q: Simplify 3m + t − 3t + 5m.
items.e: Collect the m terms (8m) and the t terms (−2t). The answer is 8m − 2t.

items.q: Simplify 3t + 5y + 4t − 2y.
items.e: Collect the t terms (7t) and the y terms (3y). The answer is 7t + 3y.
Collect the m terms (7m) and the x terms (−x), then the number. The answer is 7m − x − 7.

items.q: Simplify −m − 3n + 8m − n.
items.e: Collect the m terms (7m) and the n terms (−4n). The answer is 7m − 4n.
Collect the b terms (b) and the m terms (m), then the number. The answer is b + m − 8.

items.q: A triangle has sides x cm, (x + 3) cm and 2x cm. Write a simplified expression for its perimeter.
Pattern n of matchstick squares in a row uses 3n + 1 matches. How many matches are in pattern 10?
Which expression means “add 5 to n, then multiply by 3”?
items.e: The adding happens first, so it goes in brackets: 3(n + 5).

items.q: Which expression means “multiply n by 3, then add 5”?
items.e: Multiply first, then add: 3n + 5.

items.q: A rectangle is w cm wide and 4 cm longer than it is wide. Write an expression for its perimeter.
items.e: Length = w + 4. Perimeter = 2w + 2(w + 4) = 4w + 8.

items.q: Chloe is c years old. Her dad is 3 times her age plus 2 years. Write an expression for her dad's age.
items.e: 3 times her age is 3c, then add 2: 3c + 2.

items.q: Which expression is the same as x + x + x + 2?
items.e: Three lots of x, plus 2: 3x + 2.

items.q: Which expression is the same as x + 2 + x + 2 + x + 2?
items.e: Three lots of (x + 2): 3(x + 2), which is also 3x + 6.

items.q: A plumber charges a $90 call-out fee plus $70 an hour. Write an expression for the cost, in dollars, of h hours.
items.e: $70 for each hour and $90 once: 70h + 90.

items.q: Water drains from a 500 L tank at 20 L a minute. Write an expression for the litres left after m minutes.
items.e: 20m litres have drained: 500 − 20m.

items.q: What is the value of 2(n + 7) when n = 5?
items.e: Brackets first: 5 + 7 = 12, then 2 × 12 = 24.

items.q: Write an expression for the next even number after the even number e.
items.e: Even numbers go up in 2s: e + 2.

items.q: Write an expression for the sum of three consecutive whole numbers, starting with n.
A phone plan costs $c a month. Write an expression for the cost of one year.
items.e: 12 months: 12c.

items.q: Which is a constant in the expression 5x + 9?
items.e: A constant is a number on its own: 9.

items.q: Which expression has a variable, a constant and brackets?
items.e: 4(x − 1) has the variable x, the constant 1 and brackets.

items.q: A cricket team scored r runs on Saturday and 25 fewer on Sunday. Write an expression for the total runs.
Simplify 4x + 3 + 2x + 5.
Simplify 7n + 2m − n.
items.e: 7n − n = 6n. The m term stays: 6n + 2m.

items.q: Grace buys d drinks at $3 and s snacks at $2. Write an expression for the total cost in dollars.
items.e: Drinks cost 3d and snacks cost 2s: 3d + 2s. These are unlike terms.
